description: Canonical ASM patterns verified on NGPC hardware. Use these instead of textbook TLCS-900 sequences — textbook ones often hit silicon bugs. Source: CC900 disassembly cross-checks (Windcup) + validated NgpCraft template code.

patterns.name: function_prologue_safe
asm: link XIY, 0          ; N=0 only; N>=5 is broken on silicon
add XSP, -N          ; allocate locals (PERF-LAG-2: replaces N/2 × push WA)
notes: Use link XIY,0 max. For larger frames, do `link XIY,0` then `add XSP,-N` to allocate.
add XSP, -N uses DF C8 imm32 encoding — same family as add XSP,N post-call (safe).

patterns.name: function_prologue_cc900
asm: ; locals live in XIZ sub-regs (QIZH=low byte, IZH=mid, IZL=hi) directly
; address-taken locals: dec N, XSP / inc N, XSP instead of link
notes: CC900 never uses link/unlk. This is the target ABI for PERF-LAG-5 refactor.
Locals mapped to XIZ sub-regs = ~3-5× fewer stack ops than push WA approach.

patterns.name: vblank_wait
patterns.context: busy-wait ~200 iters — safe replacement for loops hitting D0/CB
asm: or A, W          ; C8 E1 (test zero)
notes: Uses HL-family routing to avoid CB family and D0 prefix.

patterns.name: shift_runtime_safe
patterns.context: runtime srl/sll with DA prefix — needs zero-guard
asm: ; shift A by L bits (L in HL low byte)
or A, L          ; CF E1: A|L = count; sets Z iff count==0
notes: DA prefix shift with count=0 zeros the destination (not a no-op). Always guard.

patterns.name: shift_immediate_safe
patterns.context: compile-time constant shift — use D8 prefix form
notes: D0 EE form (sll N,WA) is broken. D8 widened form is safe.

patterns.name: reg16_copy_via_stack
patterns.context: R16 pair copy — never use D1 88 (= 4-byte or BC,(mem))

patterns.name: enable_interrupts_vblank
patterns.context: Mandatory init sequence for any ASM/C program that uses joypad
asm: pop HL           ; high word of XIY
ei 0             ; NEVER write plain `ei` — that assembles to EI 7 = DI
notes: Without ei 0: no VBlank → BIOS never updates pad reg at 0x6F82 → buttons dead.

patterns.name: isr_vblank_return
asm: reti           ; NOT ret — ret corrupts CPU/BIOS state
notes: Validated Jalon 15 (2026-03-24): using ret hangs after the first VBlank.

patterns.name: block_copy_ldirw
patterns.context: ngpc_memcpy_w — LDIRW uses XIY (src) / XIX (dst) on NGPC
notes: Textbook TLCS-900 says XDE/XHL — wrong on NGPC. Use XIY/XIX.

patterns.name: dmac_load_safe
patterns.context: DMA source/dest register load from XWA
asm: ldcl dmacN, xwa         ; D8 32-bit form (E8 2E cr encoded)
notes: Never use `ldcw dmacN, wa` — that's D0 prefix, broken on silicon.
t900as.py Fix #26 corrected the zz encoding to produce E8 2E cr.

patterns.name: inc_wa_safe
asm: adc W, B           ; note: W>0 triggers adc W,B bug — use only for small WA values
notes: For larger values prefer a loop keeping W=0 (count ≤ 255).
